about: Generated by tools/gen_plugin_catalogue.py from $PATCHES in scripts/apply-patches.ps1 (the `entries`) and from the plugin.json of every plugins/ready folder that replaces no patch (the `folders`). Do not edit by hand; re-run the tool.

folders.name: skill-hub
folders.summary: the skill library's other doors: a reference manual read only when it is asked for, leading /skill and /bundle chains, a project's own skills, and /learn.
folders.why: born as a folder: it replaces no patch

folders.name: voiceprint
folders.summary: Write Like Me: Jarvis drafts in the owner's own voice, learned from his own words on his own PC, with names and numbers taken out before any of it reaches a model.
folders.why: born as a folder: it replaces no patch

folders.name: receipts
folders.summary: action receipts and one-click undo: every action that CHANGES something leaves a receipt saying what changed, with one button to put it back.
folders.why: born as a folder: it replaces no patch

folders.name: auto-router
folders.summary: estimate what a turn will cost on this PC, and advise when a cloud lane would be quicker - advice only: jarvis_router.choose() still decides, and all four safety gates must pass first.
folders.why: born as a folder: it replaces no patch

folders.name: vault
folders.summary: a secret is kept in Windows Credential Manager and everything else carries its NAME - a handle, {{vault:github}} - never the value.
folders.why: born as a folder: it replaces no patch

folders.name: notion-obsidian
folders.summary: bring a Notion export into an Obsidian vault: ids off the names, properties as frontmatter, databases as a note and a .base, links rewritten, attachments moved, with one-click Undo.
folders.why: born as a folder: it replaces no patch

folders.name: self-improve
folders.summary: two read-only diagnostic GETs: a file:line-cited answer to a question about Jarvis's own source, and the three-outcome check that Ollama is telling Jarvis the truth about what the local model can do.
folders.why: born as a folder: it replaces no patch

folders.name: media-index
folders.summary: searchable recordings and videos: GET/POST /api/media-index, so both apps can read the switch, the disclosure and the counts, turn it off at once (on asks once), and Delete the stored words.
folders.why: born as a folder: it replaces no patch

folders.name: vault-organizer
folders.summary: plan a tidy-up of an Obsidian vault without changing anything: tags merged, Map-of-Content hubs, a Vault Home - a read-only plan, OFF until the owner turns it on, with the one-card writer in a follow-up slice.
folders.why: born as a folder: it replaces no patch

folders.name: sandbox
folders.summary: the data and maths sandbox's own switch: GET/POST /api/sandbox, so both apps can read it and ask to turn it on (one approval card) or off (at once).
folders.why: born as a folder: it replaces no patch

folders.name: antislop
folders.summary: the Anti-Slop filter: miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop's rules, distilled, so Jarvis writes and builds without the AI tells - no em dashes in prose, no buzzwords or generic CTAs, no decorative code comments, and an audit that checks contrast, dead controls and focus rings.
folders.why: born as a folder: it replaces no patch

folders.name: google-calendar
folders.summary: Google Calendar, both ways: the private iCal link (read-only) or a real Google sign-in over a loopback redirect (read/write), one active at a time - and every change to an event waits on its own approval card.
folders.why: born as a folder: it replaces no patch

folders.name: android-builder
folders.summary: Build the Android app in one of your app tasks with Gradle, and put it on your phone over the cable: one approval card for the build and one for the install. The card for the build names the exact command and says that a first build downloads Gradle and the Android Gradle plugin.
folders.why: born as a folder: it replaces no patch
